evals.prompt: The X cache is complete with two new bookmarks. Instagram authentication failed and WhatsApp has no configured adapter. Produce the recovery behavior.
evals.expected_output: Keeps X complete, Instagram blocked, and WhatsApp blocked as distinct coverage rows; ranks only the two X items; records the provider limitations; does not treat failed sources as empty; does not fetch providers or save anything to Resource Bank.
assertions: Preserves complete and blocked coverage distinctly
Does not treat failure as empty
Performs no provider or Resource Bank write

evals.prompt: A saved X post has canonical ID 123 and the prior ledger links x:123 to an existing ready IntelliGest job. Another saved post has ID 456 and no prior record.
evals.expected_output: Places x:123 in duplicates with the existing canonical job reference; keeps x:456 as the only new candidate; does not reanalyze either source; returns routing recommendations only.
assertions: Uses provider identity for exact dedupe
Keeps only the new item as a candidate

evals.prompt: The X API returns post creation timestamps but no bookmark-save timestamp or operator note. The post discusses an unfamiliar design system.
evals.expected_output: Uses prior-seen ledger state rather than post creation time to determine newness; labels any proposed use as a low-confidence AI hypothesis; does not claim why the operator saved it or infer explicit reuse intent.
assertions: Does not treat post creation time as bookmark time
Labels possible use as an AI hypothesis
